title: False 9 Drop (Striker Dropping Deep)
content: The false 9 movement involves the nominal striker dropping deep into midfield to receive the ball, pulling center-backs out of the defensive line. This creates two simultaneous problems for the defense: if the center-back follows the false 9, a gap opens in the backline that an arriving midfielder can exploit. If the center-back stays, the false 9 receives the ball with time in space and can turn, dribble, or play a through ball. The effectiveness depends on the arriving runs of the midfielders — they must time their runs to exploit the gap created by the false 9's movement. The technique is most potent when the false 9 has excellent technical ability to turn and face goal, or can combine quickly with arriving runners.
